source: Make me a roleplay game like brookhaven you can get houes, tools,shhops an exact copy but just loooks different, Thank you!

answers.ask: You want it to look different from Brookhaven — should it read as modern suburban with different props, or a completely different setting such as fantasy or retro?
answers.answer: Keep it modern suburban, but use different-looking props, buildings, and layout so it has its own look.

answers.ask: Do players build their own house on an empty lot, or claim and decorate a house that is already standing?
answers.answer: Players should claim an already-standing house and decorate it; no house-building system is needed.
